meta.title: FavorNoms — All-in-one ordering platform for restaurants
meta.description: Run delivery, pickup, dine-in, KDS, POS, and driver dispatch from one platform. A one-time setup fee plus a monthly fee per branch, with a 14-day free trial. Built for US restaurants.

site.description: Run online ordering, kitchen display, POS, driver dispatch, and Stripe payments from one platform. Built for US restaurants.
site.ogDescription: Run online ordering, kitchen display, POS, driver dispatch, and Stripe payments from one platform.
site.twitterDescription: All-in-one ordering platform for US restaurants — Stripe payments, kitchen display, driver dispatch.

legacyInstall: Installed this from a restaurant’s menu? It was installed before each restaurant had an app of its own, so it can only ever open this page. Open that restaurant’s menu in your browser and install it again — the new one carries their name and logo and starts on their menu. You can remove this one afterwards.

hero.body: Take orders online, run your kitchen, dispatch drivers, take card payments, and grow your loyal customer base — without juggling five different tools.
hero.noCard: No credit card required · every feature unlocked during the trial

trustedBy: Trusted by independent restaurants from Brooklyn to Brentwood

features.title: Everything you need to run service
features.subtitle: Five apps. One database. Zero hand-offs.

storefront.title: Customer storefront
storefront.description: Branded menus on your custom domain. Cart, checkout, loyalty redemption.

kitchen.title: Kitchen Display
kitchen.description: Realtime tickets, station routing, long-press to 86 an item — keep the line moving.

payments.title: Card payment
payments.description: Take cards online and at the counter. Refunds and sales-tax compliant receipts from one dashboard.

dispatch.title: Driver dispatch
dispatch.description: Auto-route to your nearest online driver. GPS tracking customers can watch live.

marketing.title: Marketing tools
marketing.description: Push, SMS, email blasts. Loyalty points. Promo codes. Bring guests back.

reports.title: Reports & insights
reports.description: Revenue, peak hours, top items, customer LTV — without exporting to Excel.

pricing.subtitle: Every feature included.
